description.text:
An expansion pack of the Pokémon Card ★web series, released on 20 October 2001 and sold online through Pokémon Center Online, where buyers could see what their packs held straight after buying them. Its 48 cards bring older cards back with a new design, along with promotional cards that had been hard to get and cards until then found only in the Game Boy games Pokémon Card GB and Pokémon Card GB2. Some came back changed for the newer rules, with a Weakness added or recast as Supporters.

The set was never released in English, but its Dark Ivysaur and Dark Venusaur reached English players as part of the Best of Game promotional set.
